purpose: Prevent portfolio size from scaling mechanically across games with different ticket prices. Cost is part of the gate, never an afterthought.

rules.shadow: Research may evaluate large panels, but the UI must show theoretical cost and never imply authorization.
rules.realMoney: Portfolio size must be selected before the target draw and pass financial, random-baseline, sample and prospective gates.
rules.expensiveGames: For high unit-cost games, prefer concentrated portfolios. Large panels require materially stronger evidence and positive expected net value under conservative prize assumptions.
rules.noBudgetChasing: Never increase spend merely to raise jackpot coverage.

promotionRequirements: locked holdout positive after all ticket costs
matched random portfolio comparison using identical spend
